critical-local.description: Bounded broker-free Chat, real local Session recovery, approval HTTP contracts and desktop receipt integrity. No native desktop or venue acceptance is implied.

evidence.assertion: creates one broker-free Chat, decodes a local reply, and reuses its Session after restart
records real child failure and resumes the persisted native identity after restart
interrupts through HTTP, requires explicit release, and rejects an old execution interrupt after resume
waits for terminal dispatch persistence before dispose resolves
cleans transcript watchers after rejected completion and shares the failed disposal
refuses missing and stale approval hashes over real HTTP without a venue write
honors a readonly mode change after staging and server readonly policy without a venue write
serializes duplicate HTTP approvals and refuses replay after ledger restart
reports transport loss and recovers the same prepared approval after HTTP reconnect
preserves a venue rejection as a failed operation rather than successful submission
cancels a loopback read without losing the prepared approval or writing to the venue
rejects all-skipped, hook failure, nonzero and missing reports from real Vitest processes
fails required evidence omitted or skipped despite other passing assertions
rejects attempts to narrow the required gate before execution
rejects an empty or truncated receipt and a failed cleanup
